title: Freya and the Parish
author: Jonah Dunmore
blurb: Zephyrine Delacroix, a hotel concierge who notices everything, has spent five years keeping the town's secrets filed and alphabetized. Then the missing person's diary continues past the date she disappeared — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must close the one case everyone swore was closed for good, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
